req.title: Health probe returns liveness
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /health/ with HTTP 200 and a status:'ok' JSON body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /health/ returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing status:'ok'. To achieve high mutation kill rate: (1) positive EP test asserts exact status code 200 AND exact JSON body {'status':'ok'} — catches status-code mutations and body-content mutations; (2) negative NEG test verifies that an unsupported method (POST) on /health/ returns 405, not 200 — catches mutations that widen the allowed-method set or return 200 unconditionally; (3) boundary BVA test asserts the Content-Type header is application/json and that the 'status' key value is exactly the string 'ok' (not 'OK', not True, not 1) — catches constant-string mutations. Together these three tests cover the two sides of the HTTP-200 comparison, the exact body constant, and the method-not-allowed path.

tests.name: test_health_get_returns_200_and_status_ok
preconditions: FastAPI app is importable from main
health_route is registered on the app
actions: Instantiate TestClient with the FastAPI app
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_health_get_returns_200_and_status_ok():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get("/health/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.json()
    assert body == {"status": "ok"}
    assert body["status"] == "ok"

test_health_get_returns_200_and_status_ok()

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_health_response_content_type_and_exact_status_value():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get("/health/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert "application/json" in response.headers["content-type"]
    body = response.json()
    assert "status" in body
    assert body["status"] == "ok"
    assert body["status"] != "OK"
    assert body["status"] != "Ok"
    assert body["status"] is not True
    assert body["status"] != 1
    assert len(body) == 1

test_health_response_content_type_and_exact_status_value()
